families.product_name: GE Vivid cardiac AI features (Automatic View Recognition, AI Auto Measure 2D / Spectrum Recognition, Easy Auto EF / Easy AFI LV with AI Auto ROI, AI Cardiac Auto Doppler, AI FlexiViews LAA; plus AFI/Auto EF/4D Auto quantification tools)
families.company: GE HealthCare (GE Medical Systems Ultrasound and Primary Care Diagnostics, LLC; manufacturer GE Vingmed Ultrasound AS, Horten, Norway)
modality_scope: Vivid iq and Vivid T8/T9 systems (K200708, K200851, K221148, K221147)
families.summary: Cardiac AI features embedded in GE HealthCare Vivid ultrasound systems (E80/E90/E95, S60N/S70N, iq, T8/T9, Pioneer) cleared under product code IYN across ten 510(k)s from 2018 to 2025. The line began with a deep-neural-network Automatic View Recognition (K181685), added AI Auto Measure 2D and Spectrum Recognition (K200497/K200743), then Easy Auto EF and Easy AFI LV with an AI Auto ROI segmentation algorithm (K220619 and siblings; Dice >=91-92% on 45 exams), and most recently AI Cardiac Auto Doppler and AI FlexiViews LAA on Vivid Pioneer (K251169; test sets of 805-1369 individuals for Doppler and 84 for LAA). None of the ten summaries reports a clinical study.
families.intended_use_quote: Vivid Pioneer is a general-purpose ultrasound system, specialized for use in cardiac imaging. It is intended for use by, or under the direction of a qualified and trained physician or sonographer for ultrasound imaging, measurement, display and analysis of the human body and fluid.
families.indications_for_use_quote: Vivid Pioneer is intended for use in a hospital environment including echo lab, other hospital settings, operating room, Cath lab and EP lab or in private medical offices. The systems support the following clinical applications: Fetal/Obstetrics, Abdominal (including renal, GYN), Pediatric, Small Organ (breast, testes, thyroid), Neonatal Cephalic, Adult Cephalic, Cardiac (adult and pediatric), Peripheral Vascular, Musculo-skeletal Conventional, Musculo-skeletal Superficial, Urology (including prostate), Transesophageal, Transvaginal, Transrectal, Intra-cardiac, lntra-luminal and lnterventional Guidance (including Biopsy, Vascular Access), Thoracic/Pleural and lntraoperative (vascular). Modes of operation include: 3D, Real time (RT) 3D Mode (4D), B, M, PW Doppler, CW Doppler, Color Doppler, Color M Doppler, Power Doppler, Harmonic Imaging, Coded Pulse and Combined modes: B/M, B/Color M, B/PWD or CWD, B/Color/PWD or CWD, B/Power/PWD.

embedded_ai_features.name: Automatic View Recognition
embedded_ai_features.function: Deep-neural-network classification of echocardiographic views to automatically select the apical images used by AFI 2.0 (LV longitudinal strain) and Auto EF 2.0 (LV ejection fraction) instead of manual image selection.
embedded_ai_features.quote: “Automatic View Recognition” is new functionality based on deep neural network embedded into the software of Vivid E95 / Vivid E90. Automatic View Recognition is a tool for workflow improvement to AFI 2.0 and Auto EF 2.0 and provides an automated alternative to manual image selection already available on the predicate Vivid E80 / Vivid E90 / Vivid E95 (K173341).

embedded_ai_features.name: AutoEF 2.0
embedded_ai_features.function: Automated LV ejection fraction from 2D apical views; already on predicate K173341 (outside batch), updated as a workflow improvement in K181685. No AI/ML method stated.
embedded_ai_features.quote: “AutoEF 2.0” is a workflow improvement of functionality already available on the predicate Vivid E80 / Vivid E90 / Vivid E95 (K173341).

embedded_ai_features.name: AFI 2.0 (Automated Function Imaging)
embedded_ai_features.function: Automated LV longitudinal strain (speckle tracking); already on predicate K173341, updated and expanded to pediatric use in K181685. No AI/ML method stated.
embedded_ai_features.quote: “AFI 2.0” is a workflow improvement of functionality already available on the predicate Vivid E80 / Vivid E90 / Vivid E95 (K173341). In addition to the changes to the tool, we have now expanded if for pediatric use.

embedded_ai_features.name: 4D Auto LAQ
embedded_ai_features.function: Quantification of left-atrial volumes, emptying fraction and strain from live 3D (4D) data; claimed equivalent to 4D Auto RVQ. No AI/ML method stated.
embedded_ai_features.quote: The new features “4D Auto LAQ” is a new feature for quantification of Left Atrium volumes, emptying fraction and strain in live 3D (4D). The feature is substantially equivalent to the 4D Auto RVQ already present on the predicate Vivid E80 / Vivid E90 / Vivid E95 (K173341).

embedded_ai_features.name: AI Auto Measure - 2D
embedded_ai_features.function: AI-based Cardiac Auto 2D feature performing semi-automated linear measurements on parasternal long-axis (PLAX) images. Introduced in K200497 (Vivid S60N/S70N); the K200497 text layer is glyph-shifted (+3 code points, digits absent) but decodes to 'AI Auto Measure - 2D: AI (Artificial Intelligence) based Cardiac Auto 2D feature that enables semi-automated measurements on a PLAX images using similar process as IMT feature first released on Vivid 7'; the verbatim quote below is from K200708, which attributes the feature to K200497.
embedded_ai_features.quote: AI Auto Measure – 2D: same feature as cleared on Vivid S70N(K200497). It is AI (Artificial Intelligence) based Cardiac Auto 2D feature that enables automated measurements on a PLAX image.

embedded_ai_features.name: AI Auto Measure - Spectrum Recognition
embedded_ai_features.function: AI recognition of common cardiac Doppler spectra that automatically launches the Auto Doppler measurement or opens the matching manual measurement folder. Introduced in K200497; quote from K200743 (clean text).
embedded_ai_features.quote: AI Auto Measure – Spectrum Recognition: AI based Spectrum Recognition feature that enables automated recognition of common Doppler spectra and automatically starts the Auto Doppler measurement or opens the appropriate manual measurement folder.

embedded_ai_features.name: AFI 3.0
embedded_ai_features.function: LV longitudinal strain analysis extended to GE raw data and third-party DICOM images. No AI/ML method stated. Introduced in K200497; quote from K200743.
embedded_ai_features.quote: AFI 3.0: based on AFI 2.0 (cleared in Vivid E80/E90/E95, K181685), adds the ability to analyze the left ventricle on both GEHC raw data images and DICOM images from 3rd party ultrasound scanners.

embedded_ai_features.name: Auto EF 3.0
embedded_ai_features.function: Automated LV function/EF assessment on GE raw data and other-vendor DICOM images. No AI/ML method stated. Introduced in K200497; quote from K200743.
embedded_ai_features.quote: Auto EF 3.0: based on Auto EF 2.0 (cleared in K181685), adds the ability to assess LV function on raw data images acquired with GEHC scanners as well as on DICOM images from other vendors systems.

embedded_ai_features.name: AFI RV
embedded_ai_features.function: Right-ventricular longitudinal global, free-wall and segmental strain from the apical 4-chamber RV-focused view. No AI/ML method stated. Introduced in K200497; quote from K200743.
embedded_ai_features.quote: AFI RV: based on AFI 2.0 (cleared in K181685) but modified for the right ventricle (RV). It is a parametric tool giving quantitative data for right ventricular longitudinal global strain, free wall strain and segmental strain derived from the apical 4-chamber RV focused view.

embedded_ai_features.name: AFI LA
embedded_ai_features.function: Left-atrial global strain plus LA volumes and emptying fraction. No AI/ML method stated. Introduced in K200497; quote from K200743.
embedded_ai_features.quote: AFI LA: based on AFI 2.0 (cleared in K181685) but modified for the left atrium. It provides quantitative data for left atrial (LA) global strain. The tool also supports measurements of LA volumes and emptying fraction (EF).

embedded_ai_features.name: 4D Auto TVQ
embedded_ai_features.function: Quantification of tricuspid annulus and valve from 4D echo; claimed equivalent to 4D Auto MVQ. No AI/ML method stated.
embedded_ai_features.quote: 4D Auto TVQ: new feature for quantification of tricuspid annulus and valve in 4D echocardiographic data. The feature is substantially equivalent to the feature for quantification of the Mitral Valve, 4D Auto MVQ, which is already present on the predicate Vivid E80 / Vivid E90 / Vivid E95 (K170823).

embedded_ai_features.name: Scan Coach
embedded_ai_features.function: Displays guidance information to help the user acquire the correct scan plane; originally cleared on Vivid T8 (K160078, outside batch). No AI/ML method stated.
embedded_ai_features.quote: Scan Coach: same feature as cleared on Vivid T8 (K160078), is designed to display information which helps user acquire the right scan plane.

embedded_ai_features.name: Easy Auto EF (Auto EF 3.0 + AI Auto ROI)
embedded_ai_features.function: One-step LV ejection fraction: an AI Auto ROI algorithm automatically places the LV region of interest / endocardial border so Auto EF 3.0 runs without manual tracing. Tested by Dice score of the segmentation.
embedded_ai_features.quote: Added Easy Auto EF -based on AutoEF 3.0 (includes AI Auto ROI algorithm)

embedded_ai_features.name: Easy AFI LV (AFI 3.0 + AI Auto ROI)
embedded_ai_features.function: One-step LV longitudinal strain: the AI Auto ROI algorithm places the LV region of interest for AFI 3.0 speckle-tracking strain. Same AI test summary as Easy Auto EF.
embedded_ai_features.quote: Added Easy AFI LV-based on AFI 3.0 (includes AI Auto ROI algorithm)

embedded_ai_features.name: AI Cardiac Auto Doppler
embedded_ai_features.function: Two AI algorithms (Tissue Doppler, Doppler Trace) auto-trace cardiac Doppler spectra and measure peak velocities and additional heart-valve-related parameters, extending the predicate Cardiac Auto Doppler / Spectrum Recognition.
embedded_ai_features.quote: AI Cardiac Auto Doppler: AI based algorithm for auto-tracing of additional doppler spectrums added to the predicate Cardiac Auto Doppler available in the predicate Vivid E95 (K220882), introducing additional heart valve related measurements compared to the predicate Spectrum Recognition algorithm available in Vivid E95 (K220882).

embedded_ai_features.name: AI FlexiViews LAA
embedded_ai_features.function: AI workflow tool that localizes the left atrial appendage in real-time 2D or biplane TEE images (6VT probe) with a single button press; the verification section describes the task as LAA region localization and landmark extraction, with ground truth annotated as the LAA contour, circumflex and ridge point (K251169 pages 14-15).
embedded_ai_features.quote: AI FlexiViews LAA: AI based workflow tool to help localize the LAA (Left Atrial Appendage) anatomical structure in real-time 2D or Biplane images with a single button press.

performance_claims.endpoint: AI Cardiac Auto Doppler (Tissue Doppler and Doppler Trace algorithms) - verification
performance_claims.metric: feasibility score and mean absolute percent error vs. threshold
performance_claims.value: passed (feasibility >95% required; numeric error values not disclosed)
performance_claims.comparator: manual measurements by two cardiologists (ASE-based annotation guidelines) with five-expert review panel
performance_claims.dataset_description: Tissue Doppler testing dataset: 4106 recordings from 805 individuals; Doppler Trace testing dataset: 3390 recordings from 1369 individuals. Male and female; adult and pediatric; USA (several locations), Australia, France, Spain, Norway, Italy, Germany, Thailand, Philippines; consoles Vivid E80, E95, E9, iq, S70, T9, Q, Pioneer; 13 unique probes listed (6Sc, 6Vc, 3Sc, 4Vc, 4V, M5S, 6S, M4S, M5Sc, 12S, 9VT, 6VT, 10T; M5S appears twice in the 14-entry list). Test sites independent of training/validation sites.
performance_claims.subgroup_notes: n_studies here = 4106 + 3390 recordings; n_patients = 805 + 1369 individuals (the two datasets may overlap; summary does not say). Accuracy thresholds and achieved error values are not reported numerically. Preceding bullet (same page): 'The verification requirement included a step to check for a feasibility score of more than 95%, as well as an expected accuracy threshold calculated as the mean absolute difference in percentage for each measured parameter.'
performance_claims.quote: The verification requirement included a step to check mean percent absolute error across all cardiac cycles against a threshold. All clinical parameters, as performed by AI Cardiac Auto Doppler without user edits passed this check

performance_claims.endpoint: Fully automated AI GLS vs semi-automatic speckle tracking (EchoPAC v202) - research pipeline
performance_claims.metric: bias (limits of agreement)
performance_claims.value: -1.4 ± 0.3% (95% LoA 2.3 to -5.1); views classified and events timed in 89% of patients; analysis within 15 s
performance_claims.comparator: EchoPAC v202 semi-automatic speckle tracking (GE Healthcare)
performance_claims.dataset_description: 200 patients with a wide range of LV function; three standard apical cine-loops
performance_claims.subgroup_notes: Salte et al., JACC Cardiovasc Imaging 2021 (PMID 34147442). NTNU/CIUS academic pipeline with GE licensing priority; the paper does not state that it is the commercial Easy AFI product. Numbers confirmed against the PubMed abstract this session; the k_number is a topical link only.
performance_claims.quote: GLS was -12.0 ± 4.1% for the AI method and -13.5 ± 5.3% for the reference method. Bias was -1.4 ± 0.3% (95% limits of agreement: 2.3 to -5.1), which is comparable with intervendor studies. The AI method eliminated measurement variability and a complete GLS analysis was processed within 15 s.

performance_claims.metric: acquisition + processing time reduction; test-retest reproducibility
performance_claims.value: 77% time reduction (median 5.3 min); reproducibility superior inter-observer, non-inferior intra-observer
performance_claims.comparator: manual measurements (standard clinical workflow; 4 readers in test-retest)
performance_claims.dataset_description: 50 consecutive patients (real time), 40 test-retest subjects, internal and external research databases of 1881 and 849 subjects
performance_claims.subgroup_notes: Olaisen et al., Eur Heart J Cardiovasc Imaging 2024 (PMID 37883712). n_patients = 50+40+1881+849. Authors state GE Healthcare has licensing priority; not confirmed as the shipped Easy Auto EF. Numbers confirmed against the PubMed abstract this session; the k_number is a topical link only.
performance_claims.quote: Real-time AI measurements significantly reduced the total acquisition and processing time by 77% (median 5.3 min, P < 0.001) compared with standard clinical workflow. Test-retest reproducibility of AI measurements was superior in inter-observer scenarios and non-inferior in intra-observer scenarios.

performance_claims.metric: classification accuracy

State-of-the-art accuracies of 98.3% ± 0.6% and 98.9% ± 0.6% on single frames and sequences, respectively, and real-time performance with 4.4 ± 0.3 ms per frame were achieved.

performance_claims.subgroup_notes: Smistad et al., IEEE TUFFC 2020 (PMID 32175861). Academic pipeline; not stated to be the shipped Easy Auto EF. Numbers confirmed against the PubMed abstract this session; the k_number is a topical link only.
performance_claims.quote: The bias and standard deviation of the automatic EF measurements were -3.6 ± 8.1%, while the mean absolute difference was measured at 7.2% which are all within the interobserver variability and comparable with related studies.

training_data.description: Disclosed only for K251169 (as recordings, not patients): Tissue Doppler development dataset 1482 recordings from 4 clinical sites; Doppler Trace development dataset 2070 recordings from 4 clinical sites (probes M5Sc, M5S, 4Vc, 4V, M4S, 6S, 12S, 6Vc, 6VT on Vivid E80, E95, E9, 7, S70N); AI FlexiViews LAA development dataset 612 recordings from 5 clinical sites (6VT probe on Vivid E9, S70N, E95). Development sites were not used for testing. Ground truth: two cardiologists annotating per ASE-based guidelines with an expert review panel (five experts for Doppler, three for LAA). For the AI Auto ROI algorithm (K220619/K221148/K221147/K220882) the training-set size is not disclosed; the summaries state only that training and test data came from different clinical sites. No training data disclosed for Automatic View Recognition (K181685) or AI Auto Measure (K200497/K200743).
training_data.source: FDA 510(k) summaries K251169 (PDF pages 13, 15) and K220619 (page 9)

validation_data.description: K220619/K221148/K221147/K220882 (AI Auto ROI): 45 exams from assumed 45 patients, 135 images; adult; gender unknown; Europe, Asia, US; 5 probes, 4 console variants. K251169: Tissue Doppler 4106 recordings / 805 individuals; Doppler Trace 3390 recordings / 1369 individuals (adult and pediatric, 9 countries, 8 consoles, 13 unique probes listed (6Sc, 6Vc, 3Sc, 4Vc, 4V, M5S, 6S, M4S, M5Sc, 12S, 9VT, 6VT, 10T; M5S appears twice in the 14-entry list); BMI subset 41 patients / 433 measurements); AI FlexiViews LAA 342 recordings / 84 adults (5 countries, 4 consoles, 6VT probe). K181685, K200497, K200743, K200708, K200851: no validation data reported.

prior_validations.description: GE HealthCare marketing page 'Vivid AI and Automation' (fetched this session) states 'AI Auto Measure 2D achieves 98% detectability[3] and 100% reproducibility[4]', 'up to 99% classification accuracy and 98% detectability' for 'Ultra Edition AI algorithms'[3], and Easy AFI LV results in '15 seconds on average'[2]. Footnote 3 attributes its figures to the AI-based View Recognition algorithm and footnote 4 to AI Auto Measure - Spectrum Recognition, both citing GE internal data (DOC2292732); footnote 2 cites verification by GE clinical application specialists (DOC2739637). No methods or datasets given.

GE HealthCare Vivid E95 product page (fetched this session) states 'Up to 80% fewer klicks thanks to AI Auto Measure 2D' and 'up to 93% fewer keystrokes' for Cardiac Auto Doppler with AI Auto Measure Spectrum Recognition, and 'results in only 15 seconds' for Easy AFI; no methods given.

Vivid Pioneer launch coverage (ITN, Aug 29 2025; fetched this session) states the system received CE Mark and U.S. FDA 510(k) clearance and that Easy AFI provides strain and EF analyses in less than nine seconds.

papers.title: Real-Time Standard View Classification in Transthoracic Echocardiography Using Convolutional Neural Networks.
papers.key_result: CNN view classifier (up to 7 views) trained/tested on >500 patients and 7000 videos: 98.3% ± 0.6% (frames) and 98.9% ± 0.6% (sequences) accuracy, 4.4 ms per frame. Co-author from GE Vingmed Ultrasound AS. Not stated to be the Automatic View Recognition product. Abstract and GE Vingmed Ultrasound AS affiliation confirmed via PubMed efetch this session.

papers.title: Real-Time Automatic Ejection Fraction and Foreshortening Detection Using Deep Learning.
papers.journal: IEEE Transactions on Ultrasonics, Ferroelectrics, and Frequency Control
papers.key_result: Deep-learning pipeline (view classification, timing, segmentation, landmarks) trained on 500 patients, evaluated on 100 patients from another clinic: EF bias -3.6 ± 8.1%, MAD 7.2%. NTNU/CIUS academic work.

papers.title: Myocardial Function Imaging in Echocardiography Using Deep Learning.
papers.key_result: PWC-Net-based deep-learning motion estimator (average end-point error 0.06±0.04 mm/frame on simulated data) in a fully automatic pipeline (view classification, event detection, myocardial segmentation, motion estimation) for LV longitudinal strain; mean deviation -0.7±1.6% vs a semi-automatic commercial solution in N=30 patients. NTNU/CIUS academic work; not stated to be a Vivid feature. Abstract confirmed via PubMed efetch this session.

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence for Automatic Measurement of Left Ventricular Strain in Echocardiography.
papers.key_result: Fully automated AI GLS vs EchoPAC v202 semi-automatic speckle tracking in 200 patients: views classified and events timed in 89%; GLS -12.0 ± 4.1% (AI) vs -13.5 ± 5.3% (reference); bias -1.4 ± 0.3% (LoA 2.3 to -5.1); analysis within 15 s.

papers.title: Deep Learning for Improved Precision and Reproducibility of Left Ventricular Strain in Echocardiography: A Test-Retest Study.
papers.journal: Journal of the American Society of Echocardiography
papers.key_result: Two test-retest datasets (n=40, n=32): AI GLS minimal detectable change 3.7 vs 5.5 and 3.9 vs 5.2 (inter-reader), no reader bias with AI; processing time 7.9 ± 2.8 s.

papers.title: Automatic measurements of left ventricular volumes and ejection fraction by artificial intelligence: clinical validation in real time and large databases.
papers.key_result: Real-time AI LV volumes/EF in 50 consecutive patients cut acquisition + processing time by 77% (median 5.3 min); test-retest (n=40, 4 readers) reproducibility superior inter-observer and non-inferior intra-observer; good agreement in databases of 1881 and 849 subjects. Authors disclose GE Healthcare licensing priority via CIUS.

papers.title: A deep learning based method for left ventricular strain measurements: repeatability and accuracy compared to experienced echocardiographers.
papers.key_result: EfficientNetB1 model trained on cardiologist-defined ROIs from 672 exams; DL ROIs fed to commercial analysis software gave average absolute GLS difference 0.75 (95% CI 0.58-0.92) vs operators. Co-author affiliated with GE Healthcare, Oslo. Not stated to be the shipped AI Auto ROI. GE Healthcare, Oslo affiliation confirmed via PubMed efetch this session.

papers.title: Deep learning improves test-retest reproducibility of regional strain in echocardiography.
papers.journal: European Heart Journal - Imaging Methods and Practice
papers.key_result: Dual-centre test-retest data set of 40 controls and 40 patients with suspected NSTE-ACS, two consecutive echocardiograms per subject by different operators; the fully automated deep-learning method improved test-retest reproducibility of regional longitudinal strain compared with semi-automatic measurements by experienced observers (numeric values not in the PubMed abstract). NTNU/CIUS pipeline; not stated to be a Vivid feature. DOI resolved via Crossref this session.

papers.title: Real-Time Echocardiography Guidance for Optimized Apical Standard Views.
papers.key_result: Deep-learning tool that suggests transducer movements toward apical standard views, trained on slices of 3-D volumes; proposed the adequate transducer movement 75% of the time across all degrees of freedom and 95% of the time for rotation alone. Co-author affiliated with GE Vingmed Ultrasound AS (PubMed affiliation). Found via extra PubMed search this session; not stated to be the Scan Coach or any Vivid feature.

papers.title: Deep learning for automated left ventricular outflow tract diameter measurements in 2D echocardiography.
papers.key_result: U-Net model for automatic LVOT diameter in PLAX/zoomed PLAX views trained on 649 consecutive exams (1304 measurements): mean absolute error 1.04 mm (95% CI 0.90-1.19) on the test set; mean relative error 3.8-5.1% across subgroups. Co-author affiliated with GE HealthCare, Oslo (PubMed affiliation). Found via extra PubMed search this session; not stated to be the AI Auto Measure 2D feature.

papers.title: Automated Segmentation and Quantification of the Right Ventricle in 2-D Echocardiography.
papers.key_result: Deep-learning RV segmentation / keypoint detection (U-Net KP) trained and evaluated on RV-focused images from 250 participants; bias and 95% LoA vs reference 0.8 ± 10.8% for RV fractional area change, -0.04 ± 0.54 cm for TAPSE, 0.2 ± 6.6% for RV free-wall strain, comparable to inter-observer discrepancies. Co-author affiliated with GE Vingmed Ultrasound AS (PubMed affiliation). Found via extra PubMed search this session; not stated to be the AFI RV feature.

open_questions: K200497 predicate and reference K-numbers cannot be read: the 510(k) summary PDF text layer is glyph-shifted (+3 code points) and drops all digits (pdftotext, PyMuPDF, the probe extractor and pypdf all give the same result). Predicates left empty; the decoded text names 'Vivid S60N/Vivid S70N (K...)' as primary predicate and Vivid E95, LOGIQ E9, Vivid S60N/S70N and Vivid 7 as reference devices.

No accuracy data exist in any FDA summary for Automatic View Recognition (K181685), AI Auto Measure 2D, or Spectrum Recognition; the only figure is a click count (79%, 4 vs 19) in K200743. Company pages claim 98-99% detectability/accuracy and 100% reproducibility citing GE internal data documents (DOC2292732) without methods, and the page's footnotes attribute those figures to the View Recognition and Spectrum Recognition algorithms rather than to AI Auto Measure 2D as the headline sentence implies.
AI Auto ROI (Easy Auto EF / Easy AFI LV) training-set size, number of training sites, and patient demographics are undisclosed; the test set is 45 exams with patient count 'assumed'.

K251169 AI Cardiac Auto Doppler: the numeric accuracy thresholds and achieved mean absolute percent errors per parameter are not reported (only 'passed'); the BMI-subgroup 'predefined metric' is not defined and has no units; overlap between the Tissue Doppler (805) and Doppler Trace (1369) cohorts is not stated.
K251169 AI FlexiViews LAA: size of the BMI>25 subset is not stated; sensitivity/specificity definitions (per recording vs per landmark) are not given.

No peer-reviewed validation was found for AI Cardiac Auto Doppler, AI FlexiViews LAA, AI Auto Measure 2D, or Spectrum Recognition. Extra PubMed searches this session (feature names; GE Vingmed/GE HealthCare affiliation + echocardiography + deep learning; 'Vivid E95' + AI) returned only GE-affiliated research papers on view guidance, LVOT diameter and RV segmentation, none of which names a Vivid feature.
No peer-reviewed validation was found for AI Cardiac Auto Doppler, AI FlexiViews LAA, AI Auto Measure 2D, or Spectrum Recognition (PubMed searches returned no relevant hits).
No registered clinical trials were searched on ClinicalTrials.gov this session; clinical_trials left empty.
